page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.u1-c1m8.2xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped from 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of RAM, providing a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or GPU hardware, and operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps under a KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark evaluations place this instance in the average performance tier for most compute and memory tasks. It achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 1417.0 and a multi-core score of 5299.0, alongside a PassMark CPU score of 10405.69. Memory bandwidth tests show 424.06 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 53.2 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. However, the instance exhibits performance limitations in specific workloads; Redis SET operations are weak at 7.81 million operations per second, and LLM inference speeds for a medium 7B model are poor, yielding 15.81 tokens per second for prompt processing and 5.96 tokens per second for text generation.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density, the instance offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-bound workloads that do not require local NVMe storage or GPU acceleration. It is well-suited for applications such as database operations, software compilation, and static web serving, where its average memory bandwidth and 9.04 GB/sec web serving throughput can be leveraged. It is less suitable for high-throughput in-memory caching or larger machine learning inference tasks due to the documented performance bottlenecks in Redis and medium-sized LLM execution.
